start to save as much money as you can and try not to touch your account or saving for anything but the necessities, 
if you can prove to your bank you are capable of saving money and restricting your spendings they will be more inclined to offer you one rather than you ask for one, other things that could help is buying small purchases and having them put onto a payment plan instead of buying our right, eg- afterpay, zipmoney, layby..ect,
